name: ewa
description: Ẹwà: installable skincare storefront for brown and deep skin. Next.js 16 App Router, routine quiz, shade matcher, server-checked checkout, order tracking, offline PWA.

paragraphs: Skincare for brown and deep skin, from brands that started here. Ẹwà (Yorùbá for beauty) is a storefront for five African skincare and colour brands: browse eighteen products, find a routine with a short quiz, match a foundation-style shade, and check out with card, transfer or pay on delivery. Then watch the order move from packing to the rider.

It's a front-end project. The catalogue, pricing rules and payment gateway are mocks that live in this repo, so it clones and runs with no keys and no backend. The brands and products are made up; the photographs are real.
features: Shop by category, concern (dark marks, breakouts, dryness…), skin type, brand, price and stock. Filters and sort live in the URL, so any view can be shared. On phones they move into a sheet that shows the result count…
Search from anywhere with typeahead over names, brands, ingredients and concerns. Arrow keys and Enter work; results come from a real route handler (/api/products).

Product pages have a swipeable gallery on phones, sizes with live stock ("only 4 left"), shade swatches, a sticky add-to-bag bar, ingredient and how-to-use sections, and reviews you can filter by skin type and add to…
Find your shade. Tinted products have a two-question matcher (depth and undertone) that ranks the shades and picks one for you.

Routine quiz. Six questions build a morning and night routine with a reason for every step. It keeps strong actives out of reactive or pregnant routines, never stacks two at night, and adds notes like "start retinal…
